_about: Standing approvals for publishing through the Graph API. Enforced by route-gate.mjs on this machine, and by the scheduled Worker on the copy seed-kv.mjs writes into its KV queue.
An event listed under `events` may publish through post-reels.mjs without a per-post reason, and through the Worker once seeded.

Only scheduled, batch, drip or queue-owned campaigns belong here. A single post never does: it takes --graph-route "<Nino's words>" instead, and the `adhoc` ledger is refused a standing route by the gate.

Nino approves entries. An agent adds one only when he has asked for that campaign to run through the API, and quotes or paraphrases that instruction in `reason`. This file is tracked so the approval shows up as a diff.

Entry shape: "<event-slug>": { "reason": "why this campaign runs through the API", "approved": "YYYY-MM-DD", "accounts": ["letspepper"], "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD (optional)", "media_types": ["CAROUSEL", "STORIES"] (optional) }. `accounts` are accounts.json slugs and are enforced, including against --account; an entry missing any required field approves nothing.

`media_types` (added 2026-09-26, for the gallery-announce companion Story): an entry with NO media_types field covers every media type except STORIES — unchanged for every route approved before this field existed. STORIES needs an explicit, listed opt-in. route-shape.mjs's coversMediaType() enforces this, in both route-gate.mjs (local) and worker/src/index.js (scheduled).

The scheduled Worker (worker/src/index.js) cannot read this file. It checks `meta.route` in its KV queue, which seed-kv.mjs copies from the entry here and refuses to write without one. A hand-written `meta.route` in KV passes the Worker too, so this file, not KV, is the approval.
Starts empty on purpose (2026-09-21): no campaign was publishing from this machine, and the local queue copies held more than 80 overdue pending items that a stray run would have started posting.

gallery-announce.reason: Nino, 2026-09-25 (asked how much of a new-gallery announcement should run without him, answering in chat): chose "Standing auto-post" — "You approve a standing 'gallery announcements' route once; every published album posts unattended after a hold window. Needs Facebook crosspost, alt text and a hold state built first." Asked which account announces: "by series and collab with flickday" — letspepper.open for Let's Pepper series albums, nino.chavez.photo for everything else, flickday.media always a Collab collaborator. Asked which galleries are eligible given many are high-school girls' volleyball: "All galleries." `accounts` below lists the accounts.json SLUGS for letspepper.open and nino.chavez.photo (the publishing accounts this route names — flickday.media is a collaborator, not a publisher, so it is not one of the accounts a run publishes to and is not listed here). Amended 2026-09-26: the Re7kho carousel (posted from nino.chavez.photo, flickday.media invited) lists no collaborator in the Graph API, yet appears in flickday.media's tagged media, so the invite was created and later declined or removed on the flickday side. It is not a direction problem: 9/3 and 9/5 nino.chavez.photo posts show flickday.media Accepted. Asked whether to switch the held Millikin album (DWdCET) to post from flickday.media, Nino answered "yes" (2026-09-26). That answer was for that album; this entry cannot scope an account to one item, so `flickday` is listed here. Nothing selects it automatically: the builder still posts letspepper series albums from letspepper and everything else from ninophoto, so an album posts from flickday only when an operator runs seed-kv.mjs --reassign for it. Whether flickday should be the standing default publisher is Nino's open decision. Amended 2026-09-27: Nino approved the companion Instagram Story for each gallery announcement ("approve stories", in chat, after PR #62 shipped the Story behind this opt-in), so media_types now lists STORIES beside CAROUSEL. Amended 2026-09-27: "use flickday as teh standing post account and always ask if you should collab with me or someone else". Every gallery carousel now publishes from flickday.media and waits for Nino's explicit Collab decision; its linked Story waits with it and carries no collaborators.
